FAQ

Working with Lokmira.

Which businesses is this for?

Budapest service businesses that want clearer online visibility and a more organised enquiry process.

Is Lokmira focused on one industry?

No. The work is shaped around the service, target area and customer journey of each business.

Do you recommend a new website automatically?

No. We review the existing pages and enquiry process before recommending changes.

Are advertising costs included?

Media spend is separate from service fees. The budget and billing arrangements are agreed before campaigns begin.

What are the working terms?

Scope, fees, access, responsibilities and duration are agreed before work begins.
